title.value: Systematic Generalization: What Is Required and Can It Be Learned?
title.justification: The title captures the exploration of generalization abilities in neural models as discussed in the paper.
title.quote:
S YSTEMATIC G ENERALIZATION : W HAT I S R EQUIRED
AND C AN I T B E L EARNED ?

analysis.description: The paper investigates systematic generalization in neural models, specifically evaluating grounded language understanding models like modular and generic models using a synthetic VQA test. The study aims to identify if end-to-end modular models can learn layouts for better generalization.

type.justification: The paper describes various experiments on a new synthetic dataset and compares the performance of different models in terms of their generalization abilities.
type.quote: We perform all experiments of this study on the SQOOP dataset.
